record.frame: origin at the centre of the contact row on the housing's MATING face; +z the insertion direction (into the header, away from the wires), +x along the row circuit No. 1 -> No. 3, +y toward the closed back (lock side is -y). The body spans z -6.5..0; wires exit the z = -6.5 face. Units mm.

interfaces.name: mate
interfaces.what: the face that seats onto a B3B-EH-A header (part:jst-b3b-eh-a, or the socket frames on part:xl330-m288-t). Contacts at x = -2.5000, 0.0000, +2.5000. When mated this face sits 1.6000 above the header's board plane ((8.1) mated height, p.2, minus 6.5 housing height, p.3) with z anti-parallel to the header's z and x parallel (the housing is polarised — one orientation).
interfaces.source: eEH.pdf p.3 'Housing' table row EHR-3 (A 5.0, B 9.5) and drawing (3.8, 6.5, 0.6, (2.25), 2.5); p.1 'The top entry type is 3.8 mm in thickness and 8.1 mm in height'; p.2 '(8.1)'. Fetched 2026-09-04, sha256 9e35874b…, docs/fetched/eEH.pdf.

interfaces.name: wire_face
interfaces.what: the face the three crimped wires leave through, on 2.5 mm centres, each through a phi 1.9 (max insulation O.D. of SEH-001T-P0.6, p.2) hole. `accepts` empty: the wire-to-contact join is the crimp (part:jst-seh-001t-p0.6), which this shelf records as a part and not yet as a connection folder — naming one would dangle.
interfaces.source: eEH.pdf p.3 drawing height 6.5; p.2 contact table 'SEH-001T-P0.6 … Insulation O.D. 1.0 to 1.9'.
